prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: four paper document blocks; a paper ribbon.
Opens on the calendar page, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the calendar page tears into four document blocks; a paper ribbon loops round and binds them together.
Ends holding on the bound block.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 BUSINESSES".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "4 BUSINESSES". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Four acquired businesses must run unified, not as separate silos.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room light. The scene opens as <Picture 1>, showing a cream-colored paper chip with black text "Q2 2026" resting on a purple background. Immediately, a fast transition occurs: the purple background is replaced by a single, unbroken block of pale cyan matte paper. Simultaneously, the "Q2 2026" chip flips away rapidly with a slight overshoot, cleared from the frame. In the upper third of the frame, a new rectangular cream paper chip lands firmly with a slight bounce; printed on it in a large, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface is the text "4 BUSINESSES", which remains stable, clean, and legible. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a calendar page quickly tears apart into four separate, smaller document blocks. These document blocks are plain and unmarked, with no text or symbols, featuring rough white torn-paper edges and casting small, soft shadows from a consistent light source in the upper left. As the blocks settle, a flat matte cream paper ribbon loops around them in a swift, fluid motion, binding the four document blocks together into a single stack. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. By the end of the 5-second duration, the composition holds steady on the bound document blocks beneath the "4 BUSINESSES" headline. A warm, clear, and natural adult male narrator (S1) speaks with a brisk but unhurried pace, his voice synchronized to the action: <d>[English] Four acquired businesses must run unified, not as separate silos.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio features the crisp, tactile sounds of paper manipulation: a quick, sharp flick as the first chip flips away, the textured ripping sound of paper tearing into four pieces, and a soft, rhythmic paper-slap as the ribbon binds the blocks. Faint, sticky sounds of adhesive tape are heard during the transition.
